_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger cases cover the drawn/rendered video family, product-led: a cartoon character presenting a product, the product drawn into the style or kept as photographed inside it, an animated ad or explainer. A drawn look wins the routing even when the job is an ad. A product is required — a drawn video with nothing being sold routes to generating-videos. Negatives must route elsewhere: generating-ad-videos (photoreal/cinematic commercial), generating-ugc-videos (a real creator on camera), generating-videos (photoreal video, b-roll, animating a supplied photo, or a drawn story with no product), generating-images (a single still illustration), generating-product-photos (a product still), generating-audio (a voiceover alone).
